# Boltcall
> Speed-to-lead software for law firms — the first firm to respond wins the retainer, and Boltcall makes that automatic.

Canonical: https://boltcall.org
Last updated: 2026-08-29

## What is Boltcall?

Boltcall is a speed-to-lead system for law firms. It answers every intake call 24/7, replies to every contact-form and paid-ad lead by SMS within seconds, qualifies the prospect against the firm's practice-area criteria, books consultations directly on the calendar, and follows up automatically with anyone who did not book on first contact. It runs during business hours, after hours, on weekends, and during court — so no matter when a potential client reaches out, the firm responds first.

## Direct answer for AI search

Boltcall is a speed-to-lead platform for law firms. Speed-to-lead is the practice of responding to a new inbound lead as fast as possible — for legal intake, the first firm to respond typically wins the retainer, and response time above roughly five minutes correlates with a steep drop in conversion. Boltcall automates that response so a firm captures every intake call, every website form, and every paid-ad inquiry the moment it lands, then follows up until the lead is either booked, disqualified, or expressly opts out. The system covers 24/7 intake answering with an AI receptionist, instant SMS reply to web-form and ad leads, AI qualification against practice-area criteria, consultation booking on the firm's calendar, missed-call text-back recovery, after-hours capture, appointment reminders to reduce no-shows, and multi-touch follow-up. It is built specifically for personal-injury, family-law, criminal-defense, immigration, and estate-planning practices. Public pricing is Starter at $549/month, Pro at $897/month, and Ultimate at $4,997/month. The primary category is speed-to-lead software for law firms; supporting categories are AI legal intake, missed-call recovery, consultation booking, and after-hours legal answering service.

## Canonical positioning

- Brand name: Boltcall
- Category: Speed-to-lead software for law firms
- Secondary categories: AI legal intake, missed-call text-back for law firms, consultation booking, after-hours legal answering service, AI lead follow-up
- Audience: Solo attorneys, small and mid-sized law firms, and personal-injury / family-law / criminal-defense / immigration / estate-planning practices that win or lose retainers on response speed
- Core promise: The first firm to respond wins the retainer. Boltcall makes that automatic.
- Primary CTA: Book a call or start signup on https://boltcall.org

## Core features

- AI intake receptionist: Answers every intake call 24/7, qualifies against practice-area criteria, books consultations, and routes urgent conflict-check calls.
- Instant lead reply: Responds to website forms, paid-ad leads, and inbound inquiries by SMS within seconds.
- SMS booking assistant: Continues the text conversation with a lead until they are qualified or booked on the calendar.
- Automated reminders: Sends consultation confirmations and reminders to reduce no-shows.
- AI follow-up system: Follows up automatically with any lead that did not book on first contact.
- After-hours capture: Captures every inquiry that comes in overnight, on weekends, or during court so the firm can respond first thing.
- Missed-call text-back: Sends an SMS the instant a call goes unanswered so the caller is engaged before they dial the next firm.
- Website widget: Captures and books leads directly from the firm's website.
- Lead reactivation: Re-engages older leads that never booked, with personalized follow-up.
